answer: A near-duplicate is rejected at the garden gate and the submitting identity is flagged, so one good text cannot be reused across aliases. Copying an answer therefore yields nothing, and producing 125 genuinely distinct answers per epoch is real inference work with real latency; the mirror ledger keeps the similarity graph, and the zenith review can re-run it. Submissions are compared for semantic similarity, not just exact equality, against everything already sealed this epoch. That is 39 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
